dct_alternative_sm: Geologic map of the Klondike Bluffs 7.5ʹ quadrangle, Grand County, Utah
dct_description_sm: Also available on the World Wide Web.
Base from USGS Klondike Bluffs 7.5ʹ Quadrangle (1991).
Contributors: Doelling, Hellmut H., 1930- author.; Kuehne, Paul A., author.; Utah Geological Survey, cartographer.; Utah Geological Survey, publisher.
Includes a location map, a chart of adjoining 7.5ʹ quadrangle names, a stratigraphic column, geologic symbols, correlation of map units, bedrock units, and a cross section.
Project managers: Grant C. Willis ; GIS and cartography: Paul A. Kuehne and Lori J. Steadman.
Publication statement: Salt Lake City, UT : Utah Geological Survey, 2013.
Relief shown by contours and spot heights.

System requirements: Adobe Reader is required to view the PDF files. The ArcMap map document (MXD) and the ESRI file geodatabase in this digital dataset can only be viewed using ArcGIS software from ESRI. The other spatial data files in this digital dataset can be displayed using most GIS software.
